messages.text: i just ordered bitfortun BS-4 yesterday. Just wondering is that possible i change the item to HARLO B30 with top up ?
Used the store-orders skill
Used the order-swap skill

Yes, that's doable, Winson.

Swapping the BS-4 for the Harlo B30 comes to $299.01 extra. The B30 isn't in stock today, it's a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026, so a bit later than your BS-4's October 31. Once you confirm, I make the change on your order and the invoice for the difference is emailed right away; it ships once that's paid.

Want me to go ahead?
HI, possible to cancel my order 1st ?

Happy to sort it, Winson, but you don't need to cancel to get the B30. The swap keeps the same order number: the BS-4 line comes off, the B30 goes on, and you only top up the $299.01 difference. A cancel and reorder would mean paying the full $899 again and waiting on a new order.

Just so I do the right thing: do you want the B30 instead, or do you want to step away from the order entirely?
and refund

Understood, Winson. Nothing has shipped, and I've put a hold on the order so nothing moves while we sort this.

Before you decide: your BS-4 is allocated to a unit being built for you, and it ships October 31, so about a week from now. If it's the B30 you really want, the swap does that today with no new order and no money lost, just the $299.01 difference.

If you'd rather not wait at all, I can turn the full $629.99 into store credit on your account, usable on anything in stock now.
sarah, may i know if i can cancel the order and get a full refund of $629.99 directly to my orginal payment method, instead of store credit ? since the order has not yet been shipped yet

I hear you, Winson, and I won't say no to you.

One more thought first. Your BS-4 is a unit being manufactured and allocated to you, and it leaves on October 31. If the hesitation is the wait or the model, the swap to the B30 keeps every dollar you've paid working for you.

And if you'd rather keep the order as it is, I can put $50 of it back to your original payment as a thank-you for staying. Does either of those work?

Hi sarah, tq for your kind offer. i really appreciate it. i think i will prefer to cancel the order for now..i need more time to consider for my option. would it be possible to cancel the order and get full $629.99 refunded to my original paymen method ?

That's fair, Winson, and thank you for being straight with me.

I should be honest with you: cancelling isn't something we do as standard practice at our store, and it isn't mine to approve. If you'd still like to go ahead, the request goes to a supervisor for review, and they come back to you on it.

The order stays on hold in the meantime, so nothing ships while you decide. Would you like me to put that request in?

Hi Sarah, is it possible for me to change my order to the Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10TH/s) for $379 and still get the $50 coupon?

I mean, I don't want to cancel my order. I still want to purchase from you, but I would like to change to a smaller mining machine because my bedroom is quite small, and I'm worried that a bigger machine might be too loud.

So, if possible, I would like to change my order to this smaller machine and still get the $50 coupon. Is that okay?
Handed to the team · refund hold on the order blocks the swap script; I cannot lift a non-payment hol

That's good news, Winson, and the Thor P2 is a sensible pick for a bedroom. It's $379 and in stock, it ships within 2 business days.

One thing: when I swap down to a cheaper unit, the price difference comes back to you, which is worth more than the $50, so I won't double them up.

The cancellation hold I put on your order earlier has to come off before I can make the change. That's with the team, they pick it up Monday at 10am ET and confirm by email.

Yes, that's good to hear. The T. P2 is much smaller and more suitable for my bedroom. Plus, it can be shipped within 2 business days. so i no need to wait too long.

Just to confirm, the price difference is US$220, right? Will refund this amount to my original payment method?

Also, may I ask if there is a US$50 discount for first-time buyers? I think I saw something about this in the group. No worries if it doesn't apply. I'm just politely asking. Thank you

Close, Winson. It should be $220.99, the difference between the $599.99 you paid and the $379, but I'll confirm the exact cent when the swap goes through.

One thing to be straight about: a difference that size comes back as store credit on your account, not to your card. It's there for anything else you buy from us.

On the $50 first-time offer, codes like that apply at checkout on a new order, not on one already placed. Sorry I can't apply it here.

Oh yes, you're right. The price difference should be US$220.99. Thank you for clarifying that for me.

May I kindly ask how long the store credit will remain valid?

If possible, I would really appreciate it if the price difference could be refunded to my original payment method instead. Since I'm still proceeding with the purchase and only changing to a machine that better suits my needs, I was wondering if this could be considered.

I'll be honest, I don't want to guess at the validity, so I'm asking the team to confirm that for you rather than quote you something wrong.

And yes, your request for the $220.99 to go back to your card instead of credit is a fair one, since you're staying with us and just rightsizing the machine. That decision sits with the team, so I've put it to them along with the swap.

They pick this up Monday at 10am ET and confirm by email.
Handed to the team · difference over $50 defaults to store credit; customer asks for it on his card,

Both of those are now with the team, Winson: the swap to the Thor P2 and your request to have the $220.99 go back to your original payment method, plus how long store credit lasts.

Your order stays on hold in the meantime, so nothing ships and nothing is lost. You'll get the answer by email, so there's no need to wait here.
ok sure no problem sarah. then pls set my order to Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10TH/s) $379. Send to my same shipping address.

Noted, Winson, and your address stays exactly as it is, nothing changes there.

I can't make the change myself while the hold from the earlier cancellation request is on the order. Your instruction is recorded on the ticket: Thor P2 at $379, same shipping address, difference back on your card if the team can do it.

They pick it up Monday at 10am ET and confirm by email. Nothing ships before then, so your order is safe as it stands.
ok noted.

Thanks for being so easy to work with on this, Winson. A copy of our whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have the details in writing.

One thing I'm curious about, so we describe things better: what made you worry about noise, something you read about the BS-4, or the room itself?
Thank you you too sarah, because i living in a small studio unit. i need something really quite less DB. i worries more then 50DB will effect my sleeping time. this is my main concern.

That makes sense, and it's the right thing to check before the unit lands in your room.

I won't quote you a decibel figure from memory, I'd rather you get a real one. The fastest answer is our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where JD (@nullhashrate) and owners running these units day to day will tell you exactly how the Thor P2 sounds in a bedroom. I'll also ask the team to confirm the rated noise level for you when they pick this up Monday.
Yes sure. and i think Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10TH/s) Is the best option for my house. i seem their youtube video.

Sounds like you've done your homework, Winson. It's a small unit and it's on the shelf, so once the change goes through it moves quickly.

Everything from here is in the team's hands on Monday morning, and the confirmation comes to your email. If the Thor P2 turns out louder than you'd like in the studio, tell me and we'll look at it again.
ok sure. so regrading the refund $220.99. u will update me on monday right ? i hope can get this as refund instead keep in store credit. it will much happy if you can do that.

Yes, Monday is when it's picked up, and your preference is written on the ticket in your own words: the $220.99 back to your original payment method rather than store credit.

I can't promise the outcome, that call isn't mine, but it's put clearly and fairly. The answer comes to your email, and the exact amount gets confirmed when the swap is made.
OK TQ SARAH

You're welcome, Winson. It was a pleasure sorting this out with you.

You're also very welcome in our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, for setup help and new product news once the Thor P2 is with you. Enjoy your weekend.
ok noted. so my order is comfirmed riight ? Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10TH/s)

To be straight with you: your choice is confirmed, the change on the order isn't yet.

Order Shop···· still shows the Bitfortun BS-4 right now. The team makes the switch to the Thor P2 on Monday, and you'll get an updated-order email when it's done. Nothing ships before that.

So nothing more is needed from you, just watch your inbox Monday.
OK. Kindly switch to Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10TH/s) on monday. so i can get my miner soon. The power plug is malaysia type too ?

Good question, and worth raising now. The T. P2 comes as "US / EU (matched to your address)", so there's no Malaysian Type G cord in the box. It'll most likely arrive with the US cord since your order ships from our US side.

A simple plug adapter or a local C13 kettle lead sorts it. I've noted it so the team confirms which cord goes in your box when they make the switch Monday.

Okay, that sounds good. Sarah, I would really appreciate it if you could guide me step by step when the machine is ready, as I'm completely new to mining and this is my very first machine. I'm still learning and don't know much about the technical side, so I'm a bit worried about buying the wrong accessories.

If possible, it would be great if the machine could come with a Malaysian Type G power plug. If that's not available, could you please let me know exactly what power cable or adapter I should buy? I really don't want to buy the wrong one.

Thank you so much for your patience and support. I really appreciate your help

Of course, Winson, and don't worry, first machine nerves are normal. Come back here any time once it ships and I'll walk you through setup step by step.

On the cable, I don't want you buying the wrong thing on my guess. I've asked the team to confirm the exact connector on your unit and whether a Type G cord can go in the box. That comes with Monday's update, and then you'll know precisely what to buy, if anything.
Okay noted. tq sarah. really appreciate
Any time, Winson. Watch for the email Monday, and come straight back here when the Thor P2 lands so we can get it mining properly.
